name: Poland
title: BENEFITS provider tool: Poland
wave_label: No microsimulation for this country: extra income estimated from national minimum-income outlays (EUROMOD external statistics and named national sources) and Eurostat income deciles

wellby_spine.label: PLN 48,019 (HM Treasury's GBP 13,000 per WELLBY at 2019 prices, applied as GBP 16,300 at 2024 prices, converted at household-consumption PPP)
wellby_spine.provenance_note: HM Treasury (2021) Wellbeing Guidance for Appraisal, GBP 13,000 per WELLBY at 2019 prices (low 10,000, high 16,000), applied as GBP 16,300 (12,540 / 20,064) at 2024 prices by HM Treasury's own uprating method, converted at PLN 2.9460 per GBP (Eurostat prc_ppp_ind, E011 household final consumption, 2024). A transfer, flagged as such.

capacity_caveat: The capacity and shock model is INDICATIVE: demand elasticities and staff ratios are mostly UK register values, and the share of households losing an earner is the UK model's own share applied to Poland's working-age households. It is not calibrated to Poland.
provenance: No microsimulation for Poland: the income effect is estimated from the national minimum-income outlay and Eurostat income deciles, and household counts, price levels and labour costs are Eurostat database tables (nama_10_gdp, prc_ppp_ind, lc_lci_lev, lfst_hhnhtych, demo_pjan, ilc_di01, ilc_lvps02), retrieved September 2026. Provider values are per person served, in PLN at 2024 prices. Every value carries its source and a grade in its own note; a value borrowed from another country is marked.

services.name: Employment support

provenance_note.elastCentral: UK register value for Jobcentre Plus work coaches (demand moves one-for-one with unemployment, range 0.8 to 1.2), transferred unadjusted
provenance_note.elastHigh: UK register value for Jobcentre Plus work coaches (demand moves one-for-one with unemployment, range 0.8 to 1.2), transferred unadjusted
provenance_note.staffRatio: UK register benchmark, shown for reference only: no formula in the tool reads it; the extra-caseworker figure uses the provider's own cases per caseworker.
provenance_note.unitCost: PLN 2,582, converted from the UK tool's unit cost for Jobcentre Plus work coaching, GBP 1,200 per participant, itself an assumption declared at the 2024 base. Converted on average hourly labour cost in health and social work (Eurostat lc_lci_lev, NACE Q, 2023: Poland EUR 15.10 an hour; UK GBP 30.2165), ratio 2.151724. No verified Poland figure for this unit was found. CONVERSION: GBP 1200 x 2.15172439. PRICE BASE: 2024-equivalent. Unit: one participant in an employment-support episode.

services.flag: Unit: one participant in an employment-support episode. Outcome value: borrowed from another country without adjustment. +0.46 WELLBY for a move from unemployment into work (Clark et al. 2018, the Britain fixed-effects coefficient HM Treasury's guidance uses), valued at the WELLBY value for Poland, then staged as in the UK tool: effect 0.11 / 0.30 / 0.46 x attribution 0.20 / 0.22 / 0.27. European trial evidence (Card, Kluve and Weber 2018) puts job-search assistance impacts at 1 to 2 percentage points, which suggests the staged central may be high. services.flag: Unit: one claim supported. Outcome value: borrowed from another country with a stated adjustment. Income effect: the extra-income figure. Health-service use avoided: Liverpool Citizens Advice on Prescription (SSM Population Health 2025), an instrumental-variable study on linked NHS records: GBP 91 per person a year (95% CI 44 to 107) at 2023 prices, an impact, so attribution 1.0. The saving is per household member; the central counts the client only, the high counts every member (20,773 members of 8,205 client households). Uprated to 2024-25 on ONS L8GG and converted at household-consumption PPP (Eurostat, 2024). The advice covered benefits, debt and housing together. services.flag: Unit: one recipient for a year. Outcome value: an assumption. Excluded for every country: no robust per-person effect exists. Randomised evidence shows small effects on food insecurity (for example Briefel et al., -2.8 points) and none on wellbeing; the Greek DIATROFI school-meal trial is a different service. The tool shows the income effect only, as a floor.

Being in arrears lowers life satisfaction by 0.355 points (FCA / Simetrica-Jacobs 2020, individual fixed effects). services.flag: Unit: one child supported at home for a year. Outcome value: a national source. A year of out-of-home care costs PLN 178,990 per child (Prezydent m.st. Warszawy (2025), Zarzadzenie Nr 550/2025 z 31 marca 2025 w sprawie ustalenia srednich miesiecznych wydatkow przeznaczonych na utrzymanie dziecka w 2025 roku w placowkach opiekunczo-wychowawczych, PLN 15,347 x 12 months at 2025 prices, uprated on the GDP deflator.). Reduction in the chance of a residential placement: central 0.056 (Italy, P.I.P.P.I. against a comparison group, residential placements only: 6.4% against 0.8%), high 0.119 (the same, counting day foster care too), low zero (Al et al. 2012 meta-analysis: intensive family preservation generally does not prevent placement). One year of placement avoided is counted, which is conservative. The sensitivity row is the UK tool's route: the lifetime cost of a maltreatment case (Bocconi 2013, Italy) x 0.086. services.flag: Unit: one client for a treatment year. Outcome value: borrowed from another country without adjustment. Value of a statistical life for Poland: PLN 13,652,253 (OECD 2025 base VSL for the EU, USD 8.4m at 2022 PPP, transferred by GDP per head in PPS with income elasticity 1.0, as the OECD recommends). Deaths averted per 1,000 opioid-client-years: central 21.45 (France, 175,000 patients, 2026), low 6.5 (Czechia), high 24.8 (Sordo et al. 2017, methadone). Share of clients who are opioid clients: 0.160 (UNODC (2025), World Drug Report 2025, Statistical Annex 5.1: Treatment by primary drug of use: 680 / 4249 = 0.16. It counts people starting treatment in the year, so it understates the opioid share of a year's caseload: a lower bound). Non-opioid clients carry no averted-death value in these figures. ORIGIN 13652252.5939883757 FACTOR 0.003432; BAND ORIGIN 11376877.1616569795 AND 15927628.026319772; BAND FACTOR 0.00104 AND 0.003968; STAGE EFFECT 1 1 1 ATTRIBUTION 1 1 1; PRICE BASE: 2024-equivalent.
